title: Geophysical Processes Shaping Coastal & Arid Features
subject: Geography
description: A flowchart illustrating the key geophysical processes such as plate tectonics, sea-level fluctuations, wind-driven erosion, monsoonal dynamics, and anthropogenic modification that shape straits, canals, deserts, and seas.
